channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jamal Crawford | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jamal Crawford from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jamal Crawford, Lou Williams, Cam Thomas
item.description:
The 24-year-old’s performance was so impressive that Doc Rivers compared Thomas to two of the greatest Sixth Men ever whom he coached during his 27-year NBA career.

“It’s unbelievable. I’ve had Jamal Crawford, I’ve had Lou Williams, and now I have Cam Thomas,”

Doc Rivers on Jamal Crawford, Lou Williams, Cam Thomas, Feb 12, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Paolo Banchero on Jamal Crawford, Jason Terry, Isaiah Thomas, Doug Christie
item.description:
Paolo Banchero:

“Seattle, I think Seattle is pound-for-pound the best basketball factory in the country. When you look at just the depth we have in the history, we got years on years—whether it’s Doug Christie, one of the first OGs, then you got Jason Terry, Isaiah Thomas, Jamal Crawford. You know, the list goes on and on and on from generation to generation, year by year. And, um, I feel like I’m kind of new generation. Both my mom and dad are both from Seattle, so, you know, it’s in my blood, and yeah, I just take it with me wherever I go.”

Paolo Banchero on Jamal Crawford, Jason Terry, Isaiah Thomas, Doug Christie, Oct 25, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Vince Carter, Jamal Crawford, Steve Smith
item.description:
“I hope the NBA stays with TNT, but for me personally, I wanted you guys to hear it from me ...I wanted to tell my NBATV and TNT family that I'm not going to another network, but I'm going to pass the baton to either Jamal Crawford or Vince Carter or you Steve (Smith),”

Charles Barkley on Vince Carter, Jamal Crawford, Steve Smith, Jun 15, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Paul George on Brandon Roy, Jamal Crawford
item.description:
“He's got shades of off the bounce stuff like Jamal Crawford. He's got the scoring ability like Brandon Roy... He's scary NOW.”

Paul George on Brandon Roy, Jamal Crawford, Nov 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jacque Vaughn on Crawford:

“He’s a guy you could take to a playground anywhere across the world and he’d feel comfortable…that’s a special talent.”

Jacque Vaughn on Jamal Crawford, Jul 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Vaughn on Jamal Crawford:

“What Jamal brings to this team is the ability to make shots, leadership, as we advance here has played in high level games and is really comfortable playing on the floor.”

Jacque Vaughn on Jamal Crawford, Jul 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Igor Kokoskov on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
#Suns coach Igor Kokoskov on addition of Jamal Crawford:

“Definitely somebody who is capable. We know his ability to score — he’s an instant offense guy. But also, another leadership (guy)...I think the time for adjust and to adapt to a new system is going to be very quick.”

Igor Kokoskov on Jamal Crawford, Oct 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Blake Griffin on JJ Redick, Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Griffin told The Vertical.

“With Chris gone, it changed our dynamic. For me, of course, I can look at it: I have the responsibility on my shoulder – all season. I have to do it. When Chris sat out, I was able to show it. I want to prove that I can sustain that style of play. Chris was one person, but we also lost J.J. [Redick], who I knew going into the free-agency process wouldn’t be back, Jamal [Crawford], who I thought we’d keep this summer but we had to move him around. So part of our core guys separated and that affected us. It changed the philosophy and we had to be accepting of the challenge.”

Blake Griffin on JJ Redick, Jamal Crawford, Oct 27, 2017. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
“Crawford still doesn’t play like anybody else, nor does anyone really play like him. He skips as much as runs, his dribble nearing chest height, where coaches teach you not to keep it. When he crosses over, he does so precipitously and with devastating speed. From afar he appears to be all limbs upon which a giant round head bobs, as if the character from those life is good T-shirts came to life. “Damn, you got a lot of juice left in those legs!”

Dirk Nowitzki on Jamal Crawford, Oct 25, 2017. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
“The stuff he does is unbelievable. All respect to Jamal Crawford, I don't even think it should've been close for Sixth Man with Enes.”

Russell Westbrook on Jamal Crawford, Apr 28, 2016. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Jamal Crawford, Enes Kanter Freedom
item.description:
Royce Young:Westbrook on Kanter:

“All respect to Jamal Crawford, but I honestly don't think [Sixth Man] should've been close.”

Russell Westbrook on Jamal Crawford, Enes Kanter Freedom, Apr 24, 2016. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Jason Terry, Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Isaiah Thomas on Jamal Crawford:

“He's meant the world to me. Without him and guys like Jason Terry, I wouldn't be in the position I am.”

Isaiah Thomas on Jason Terry, Jamal Crawford, Mar 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Austin Rivers on whether Crawford needed a game like that:

“No, Jamal can go 0-for-30 and think he's hot. That's what makes him who he is.”

Austin Rivers on Jamal Crawford, Nov 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:DeAndre Jordan on @Jamal Crawford :

“I'm a fan, honestly. The guy had almost 40 points. He's Benjamin Button. Being as old as he is, ready to play at all times.”

DeAndre Jordan on Jamal Crawford, Nov 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Mark Berman:Steve Kerr on Steph fined $5K for flopping:

“I am morally outraged. I don't think a game goes by where Jamal Crawford doesn't flop 6 times on his 3point shots. Everybody does it. Randomly to fine Steph just seems kind of strange”

Steve Kerr on Jamal Crawford, May 20, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Doc Rivers, on the goal of having injured G @Jamal Crawford play before playoffs:

“That would help us, & help him more than it would help us.”

Doc Rivers on Jamal Crawford, Apr 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Avery Bradley on Jamal Crawford, Spencer Hawes
item.description:
But a couple of his friends on the Clippers from Seattle may try to be in Glendale, Ariz.

“Me, Spencer (Hawes) and Jamal (Crawford) were talking before the game Monday, and they were saying that if they have enough free time, they might even go to the game,”

Avery Bradley on Jamal Crawford, Spencer Hawes, Jan 23, 2015. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Paul Allen on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Are you basically saying you don’t want to go back to a rebuilding phase: Paul Allen:

“I think when you sign a Jamal Crawford, and you have LA ... you’ve got potential to be very, very competitive. There’s obviously a tipping point where you say Oh, I don’t have an All-Star caliber player to build around, and then you say it’s time to reduce salary, go back and go young and go through rebuilding process. But obviously with the moves we’ve made that’s not in the cards for this year.”

Paul Allen on Jamal Crawford, Dec 20, 2011. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Andy Miller on Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Mike Wells:Agent Andy Miller on Crawford's situation:

“We've had interest in Indiana. We've made it clear they're one of the teams we're considering.”

Andy Miller on Jamal Crawford, Dec 11, 2011. Source: Twitter.
